story.iWant: a rule engine to evaluate content and trigger alerts
story.soThat: users receive notifications for content matching their criteria
story.tasks: 1. Create AlertRule Pydantic model with conditions, 2. Create AlertEngine class in src/alerts/engine.py, 3. Integrate with BaseWatcher to trigger evaluations, 4. Store alert events as JSON with timestamp, content_id, rule_id, 5. Implement deduplication logic (content hash + time window), 6. Create comprehensive test suite for AlertEngine

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Given new content is detected by watchers, When the alert engine evaluates the content, Then it checks against all active user alert rules 2. And rules support conditions: source_match, keyword_match, category_match, price_threshold 3. And matching content generates alert events 4. And alert events are stored in data/alerts/{user_id}/events/ 5. And duplicate alerts within 1 hour are suppressed

item.title: Epic Breakdown - Story 3.1 Backend Alert Rule Engine
item.snippet: Story 3.1 establishes the foundational backend alert rule engine that will evaluate content from the existing BaseWatcher system and trigger alerts when content matches user-defined criteria.

item.snippet: BaseWatcher pattern for state persistence, Pydantic models for type safety, JSON file storage for performance, and Flask-Login for authentication.

ecosystem.name: python
ecosystem.package: Testing framework for comprehensive test suite

constraints.constraint: Must integrate with existing BaseWatcher framework without breaking existing 50+ ETL pipelines
Use file-based JSON storage for alert events in data/alerts/{user_id}/events/ directory
Alert evaluation must not block watcher processing - implement async evaluation
Follow existing Pydantic model patterns for type safety and validation
Achieve >70% test coverage using pytest patterns established in project

interface.name: AlertRule
interface.signature: class AlertRule(BaseModel): conditions: Dict[str, Any], active: bool, quiet_hours: Optional[TimeRange]

tests.standards: Follow existing pytest patterns with >70% coverage target. Test files in Tests/alerts/ with comprehensive coverage of rule evaluation logic, deduplication behavior, BaseWatcher integration, and performance under load. Use mocking for external dependencies and fixtures for consistent test data.
tests.locations: Tests/alerts/ (test_alert_engine.py, test_models.py), Tests/integration/ for BaseWatcher integration tests

test.idea: Test rule evaluation for each condition type (source_match, keyword_match, category_match, price_threshold)
Test deduplication logic with 1-hour window using content hashing
Test async evaluation doesn't block BaseWatcher processing
Test JSON file storage structure and naming conventions
Performance test with multiple rules and content items
